ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low white-to-black ratio approximately 0.05:1; surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity black pixels with sparse high-intensity clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a solid black contiguous region. High-contrast white/grey-scale clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes and at the center base near the peduncle connection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 45-50 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth extending inward approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by jagged peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the peduncle, sweeping outward and upward; the left lobe terminates in a more vertical, irregular jagged distal edge compared to the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white and brown pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; several circular white 'cookie-cutter' style clusters are visible on the mid-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular tissue accumulation/scarring on both fluke tips; circular depigmented lesions visible on the right lobe; significant secondary notch indentation on the right lobe inner trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct secondary indentation or 'double notch' feature located on the right lobe's interior trailing edge, immediately adjacent to the primary median notch.
